execution.cli_control: Generate all nine rows with one fresh CLI process and the selected checkpoint.
execution.http_cold_starts: Start one fresh server per seed, bind a no-overwrite startup receipt, and generate the three matching prompt rows through HTTP.
execution.restart_probe: Restart seed 42 in a new process and repeat neutral-brief. Compare both HTTP WAV hashes and the matched CLI WAV hash.
execution.malformed_request_probe: Require fixed-artifact path injection, wrong model, and unsupported format to fail before synthesis with their frozen status and error codes.
execution.overlap_probe: Send two overlapping structured-long-form requests and require one HTTP 200 plus one HTTP 429 server_busy response.
execution.source_checkout: Use a clean detached checkout of the committed feature revision and leave it unmodified.

runtime_smoke_tested: All nine planned CLI rows are valid.
All nine planned HTTP rows are valid and bound to their startup receipts.
Each matched HTTP and CLI WAV is byte-identical.
The seed 42 restart WAV is byte-identical.
All malformed-request and overlap probes pass.
runtime_validated: The complete objective evaluation matrix and blinded listening gates pass at a scope sufficient for a quality claim.

failure_policy: Retain failed rows and probe reports. Do not promote runtime status beyond the evidence.
boundaries: This slice excludes instruction-bearing prompts because the HTTP subset does not implement emotion instructions.
Exact WAV parity is a deterministic mechanism result, not a quality result.
One host and one selected checkpoint do not establish load capacity, ingress security, cancellation, OOM recovery, or production readiness.
The artifact manifest does not content-bind every inherited dependency under the model directory.
